rows.itemTitle: RENEWAL TERMINATION TRANSFER AND DISPUTE RESOLUTION
rows.summary: The 2025 Item 17 adds detailed renewal timing, Virtual Kitchen-specific termination and non-compete terms, a $7,500 transfer marketing fee, refresher training, and new termination obligations, while expanding several termination triggers and restructuring the former Area Development Agreement into a Development Rights Agreement with reduced franchisor acquisition rights but broader franchise-agreement cross-defaults.
